• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience building software for data privacy or security (e.g., identity and access management).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience of working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Experience building security tooling.

• Experience in static analysis or dynamic analysis.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

• Write product or system development code.

• Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

• Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

• Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

• Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

titleByLocale.it: Enterprise Account Executive, Google Cloud, DACH
titleByLocale.en: Enterprise Account Executive, Google Cloud, DACH
titleByLocale.de: Enterprise Account Executive, Google Cloud, DACH
titleByLocale.fr: Exécutif de compte d'entreprise, Google Cloud, DACH

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of sales experience in the technology industry with SaaS, PaaS or IaaS products and platforms.

• Experience engaging with accounts, selling a portfolio of products at C-level.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience selling Cloud Solutions, Infrastructure Software, Databases, Analytic Tools, or Applications Software across multiple industries, aligning solutions to drive business outcomes.

• Experience working with, and leading, cross-functional teams and partners in implementations and negotiations.

• Experience with commercial and legal negotiations, working with Procurement, Legal, and Business teams.

• Experience working with Customer Engineers and customers' technical leads to inventory software estate, define migration plans, and build migration business cases.

• Ability to communicate in English and German or French languages fluently to interact with the clients.

• Passion for building Greenfield territories, acquiring new logos and securing foundational workload(s) to accelerate consumption revenue.

About the job
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

In this role you will manage Google Cloud's relationship with some of the largest enterprise companies and grow Google Cloud's footprint with these accounts.

You will be responsible for setting the overall account strategy and working effectively with numerous cross-functional partners and sales specialists to execute against this strategy.

You will lead the engagement with a group of cross-industry enterprise customers and assist them in solving their business challenges with our solutions. Your success will rely upon your ability to identify specific business problems working with stakeholders across your accounts, and partnering with your extended team to develop technical solutions to solve them. You will be responsible for building meaningful relationships across various levels within the customer, from developers to C-suite executives.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €100000 - €102000 (EUR) + 150% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Lead prospecting and acquisition of net new business, creating and building customer relationships from scratch, and establish yourself as a trusted advisor on their long-term technology and business decisions.

• Become an expert on the customers' business, including their SaaS product portfolio, technology strategy, strategic growth plans, business drivers, financial structure, customer base, vertical market offering and competitive landscape.

• Lead account strategy to develop business growth opportunities, working cross-functionally with multiple teams and Google Partners, to maximize business impact within enterprise customers.

• Manage complex sales cycles, presenting to C-level executives and negotiating terms.

• Drive business development, own operational excellence at scale, forecast accurately, and achieve strategic goals by leading customers through the entire business cycle.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience in software development.

• 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.

• Experience in C++, Java and TypeScript.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

• 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Passionate about frontend and making user experience delightful.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Responsibilities

• Write and test product or system development code.

• Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

• Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

• Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

• Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer III, Google Cloud GTM (French, German)

titleByLocale.it: Forward Deployed Ingegnere III, Google Cloud GTM (French, German)
titleByLocale.en: Forward Deployed Engineer III, Google Cloud GTM (French, German)
titleByLocale.de: Forward Deployed Ingenieur III, Google Cloud GTM (French, German)
titleByLocale.fr: Forward Deployed Ingénieur III, Google Cloud GTM (French, German)

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

• Experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., LLMs, Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision).

• Ability to communicate in French or German fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's or PhD degree in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and complex patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.

• Knowledge of "Large Language Model (LLM)-native" metrics (tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

• Ability to implement secure agentic workflows incorporating MCP, tool-calling, and OAuth-based authentication.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Leading with the future, the AI GTM team are trusted AI advisors, scaling across Google to deliver transformative customer experiences that shape the next generation of their business. Partnering to provide deep AI expertise, thought leadership, and industry best practices, we revolutionize customer outcomes.
 It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You will leverage Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the lead developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on investment (ROI).

• Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.

• Build high-performance evaluation (Eval) pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

• Identify repeatable field patterns and technical "friction points" in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

• Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Cloud AI Research, Co-Scientist

titleByLocale.it: Software Ingegnere III, Cloud AI Ricerca, Co-Scientist
titleByLocale.en: Software Engineer III, Cloud AI Research, Co-Scientist
titleByLocale.de: Software Ingenieur III, Cloud AI Forschung, Co-Scientist
titleByLocale.fr: Software Ingénieur III, Cloud AI Recherche, Co-Scientist

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in Python, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.

• 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

• 1 year of experience with Research and Artificial Intelligence.

Preferred qualifications:

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience with software development in C++.

• Experience with system design, distributed computing, machine learning.

• Experience with Research publications.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Cloud AI Research - Co-Scientist is a research team with the mission to accelerate scientific discovery with AI. In this role, you will develop a system for scientific discovery which entails literature research, data analysis, hypothesis generation and validation. The ultimate goal is to build a system that assists scientists from diverse fields with their hardest problems. You will use Google’s latest AI tools and models and have the opportunity to collaborate with scientists in Google and from universities and partner labs.
 The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

Responsibilities

• Develop projects and components end-to-end on the Cloud software stack.

• Build, and deploy agentic AI systems, robust tool-use mechanisms, and multi-agent workflows.

• Analyze datasets, make data driven decisions, develop quality criteria and scoring rubics for AI systems.

• Collaborate with scientists and researchers across Google DeepMind, Google Research, and prestigious external academic partners to publish original research.

You will use Google’s latest AI tools and models and have the opportunity to collaborate with scientists in Google and from universities and partner labs.

• Analyze datasets, make data driven decisions, develop quality criteria and scoring rubics for AI systems.

• Collaborate with scientists and researchers across Google DeepMind, Google Research, and prestigious external academic partners to publish original research.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Security Surveillance

titleByLocale.it: Security Ingegnere, Security Surveillance
titleByLocale.en: Security Engineer, Security Surveillance
titleByLocale.de: Security Ingenieur, Security Surveillance
titleByLocale.fr: Security Ingénieur, Security Surveillance

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 1 year of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling.

• 1 year of experience with programming in Python, Go, C/C++, or Java.

• Experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.

Preferred qualifications:

• 3 years of relevant work experience, including experience in responding to security problems in target-rich environments, looking at security alerts, front-line analysis, and response.

• Expertise in the analysis of large data sets and intrusion detection systems.

• Expertise with signals development, threat hunting, and threat modeling.

• Knowledge of modern AI/ML frameworks and tools, including experience in prompt engineering.

About the job
 Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

The Security Surveillance team monitors Google’s network and systems for threats to information security. We strive to accomplish this in the least intrusive way possible, protecting Google’s culture and innovative practice.
 The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

• Participate in a 24/7 global operation that hunts for and responds to security events on Google's networks.

• Perform investigations on a wide variety of events from various sources to determine whether they pose a threat to Google.

• Work with teams from around Google to discover new detection capabilities and logging sources.

• Design, develop, and deploy scalable software systems and frameworks to automate complex security workflows.

• Research and implement AI/ML techniques for security applications, including the development and tuning of LLM-based autonomous agents.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer I, Google Cloud Consulting (French, German)

titleByLocale.it: Forward Deployed Ingegnere I, Google Cloud Consulting (French, German)
titleByLocale.en: Forward Deployed Engineer I, Google Cloud Consulting (French, German)
titleByLocale.de: Forward Deployed Ingenieur I, Google Cloud Consulting (French, German)
titleByLocale.fr: Forward Deployed Ingénieur I, Google Cloud Consulting (French, German)

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.

• Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.

• Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch, and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform).

• Experience leading technical discovery sessions with customers.

• Ability to communicate in French or German fluently as this is a customer-facing role that requires interactions in French or German with local stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).

• Experience in a post-sales or technical consulting delivery function.

• Knowledge of Large Language Model (LLM) native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

About the job
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in the Google Cloud Consulting organization, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.
 It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

• Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).

• Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.

• Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

• Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

• Co-build with pre-sales and product teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Cloud Red Team, Cloud CISO

titleByLocale.it: Senior Security Ingegnere, Cloud Red Team, Cloud CISO
titleByLocale.en: Senior Security Engineer, Cloud Red Team, Cloud CISO
titleByLocale.de: Senior Security Ingenieur, Cloud Red Team, Cloud CISO
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Security Ingénieur, Cloud Red Team, Cloud CISO

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience in a technical security role (e.g., security engineering, security research, DevSecOps, or incident response).

• Experience with vulnerability assessments and vulnerability exploitation.

• Experience in security and ethical hacking.

Preferred qualifications:

• 3 years of offensive security experience (red teaming, vulnerability research, pen testing, etc - not just running tools) in Cloud environment.

• Experience with Artificial Intelligence.

• Ability to develop custom exploits, modify existing exploits, and bypass security controls.

• Fluency in programming languages relevant to security and cloud automation (e.g., Python, Go, Bash).

• Being able to clearly and concisely articulate complex technical findings, risks, and remediation strategies to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.

About the job
Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As a part of the Product Security Engineering team within the Cloud CISO organization, you will be responsible for helping ensure every product in Cloud is as secure as it can be, and increasing the security in the infrastructure underlying all our products.

As a part of the Cloud Red Team, your mission is to evaluate our ability to detect and respond to known and unknown threats by simulating real-world adversaries that aim to compromise and persist in Cloud’s infrastructure. In short: Hack Cloud to make hacking Cloud harder.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Define and maintain the roadmap for one of the programs within Cloud Red Team, while collaborating within a highly-skilled team to plan and execute attacks against Cloud’s products, services, and infrastructure.

• Build tools and infrastructure to support attacker goals, while identifying vulnerabilities and attack vectors across Cloud services, configurations, and related technologies.

• Participate in threat modeling exercises to identify potential attack paths and weaknesses in Cloud architectures and deployments.

• Design realistic and relevant attack scenarios based on current threat intelligence and the specific Cloud environment being assessed.

• Create reports that capture the insights gained during an attack and present them to a variety of audiences.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Google Cloud, Applied AI, Automotive AI Agent

titleByLocale.it: Staff Software Ingegnere, Google Cloud, Applied AI, Automotive AI Agent
titleByLocale.en: Staff Software Engineer, Google Cloud, Applied AI, Automotive AI Agent
titleByLocale.de: Staff Software Ingenieur, Google Cloud, Applied AI, Automotive AI Agent
titleByLocale.fr: Staff Software Ingénieur, Google Cloud, Applied AI, Automotive AI Agent

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

•

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in software development and working with algorithms.

• 5 years of experience with software development in one or more general-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, C++).

• Experience building and maintaining distributed systems, cloud APIs, and mobile or embedded software development kits (SDKs).

• Experience with AI/ML technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs) or Natural Language Understanding (NLU).

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in productizing and productionalizing applied ML/NLP systems.

• Familiar with LLM technologies and experience in production-grade LLM-based applications.

• Ability to optimize systems end-to-end, ensuring safety and quality in a safety-critical automotive environment.

• Passion for innovations and converting new technologies (like "Live Mode" or Agentic workflows) into tangible product value.

About the job
 Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Join the Automotive team as we are building the leading development platform for the AI-defined vehicle. We provide automotive original equipment manufacturer (OEMs) with a Gemini-native platform to build, deploy, and maintain intelligent agents. By adding vehicle integration with Gemini’s reasoning, we empower automakers to deliver proactive and personalized experiences that connect the driver's life inside and outside the car.
 In this role, you will help us define the future of in-car interaction, ensuring our solutions are fully functional, localized for and scalable across customers, domains and various locations.
 The Cloud Applied AI (AAI) powers business growth with Gemini Enterprise. Our portfolio includes Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (Shopping Agent, CX Agent Studio, Agent Assist, Vertex AI Search - Commerce, Customer Experience Insights), along with other vertical and domain packaged solutions. We enable high adoption and speed to value by building solutions that are quickly deployed, delivering new 0-to-1 capabilities with startup agility. Team members operate at the forefront of AI, collaborating directly with model builders with unprecedented speed. Join us to work on cutting-edge projects and shape the future of AI in a fast-paced, collaborative, and impactful environment.

Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable server-side infrastructure for the automotive AI agent platform using C++ and Go.

• Build and evolve one platform APIs, managing their lifecycle from experimental to general availability, ensuring they meet Google Cloud standards.

• Implement and integrate Google Cloud technologies and best practices, including control plane framework engine (CCFE), and ensure compliance with security and privacy horizontals (e.g., access transparency (AxT), customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK), virtual private cloud service controls (VPC-SC), data residency zones (DRZ)).

• Contribute to the design and implementation of backend systems supporting platform features, including potential monetization mechanisms.

• Write well-tested, production-ready code and participate in on-call rotations to support service reliability.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Graduate of the highest level of secondary school.

• Academic grades in the average of 4.5 or higher.

• Completed Multicheck (ICT).

• Ability to communicate in English and German fluently, to interact with stakeholders and schools.

Preferred qualifications:

• First experience and strong interest in writing code.

• Passion for new technologies and a strong motivation to learn.

• Genuine enthusiasm for reading technical texts.

• Demonstrated logical and abstract thinking.

• Have authorization to work in Switzerland.

About the job
 A professional team of vocational trainers (Berufsbildner:innen) will guide and support you during your 4-year apprenticeship with Google. After a 1-year foundation course (Basislehrjahr) you will join your Google team in Zurich and will be fully engaged in existing and new projects that will challenge you and lay the foundation for a successful future as an application developer.
 As a Computer Scientist Apprentice focused on Application Development, you'll dive into software design and development, working alongside various front-end and back-end teams across Google's product suite. This immersive experience will expose you to the varied roles and career paths within this dynamic field.
 We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to address some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

• Proactively analyze a range of problems, identify potential solutions, and implement them effectively.

• Foster strong collaboration within your team, clearly communicating ideas and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code that aligns with project requirements, and conduct solid testing to ensure functionality and reliability.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Search Ads, Quality and AI

titleByLocale.en: Software Engineer III, Search Ads, Quality and AI
titleByLocale.it: Software Ingegnere III, Search Ads, Quality and AI
titleByLocale.de: Software Ingenieur III, Search Ads, Qualität and AI
titleByLocale.fr: Software Ingénieur III, Search Ads, Qualité and AI

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 3 years of experience with software development in C++ and Python or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience with machine learning tools and algorithms, specifically deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) and deep learning models.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 1 year of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.

• Knowledge of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, and Generative AI.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.
 Responsibilities

• Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.

• Perform model training, evaluation, and deployment to solve business-critical problems.This includes exploration of new model architectures, augmenting existing training data, finding better evaluation methods and feedback signals, and identifying headroom opportunities.

• Understand production systems, visualize, monitor, and optimize performance.

• Stay up-to-date with latest tools and research in the field working actively with our collaborators.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, AI/ML Shopping Creator, YouTube

titleByLocale.en: Software Engineer III, AI/ML Shopping Creator, YouTube
titleByLocale.it: Software Ingegnere III, AI/ML Shopping Creator, YouTube
titleByLocale.de: Software Ingenieur III, AI/ML Shopping Creator, YouTube
titleByLocale.fr: Software Ingénieur III, AI/ML Shopping Creator, YouTube

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.

• 1 year of experience with Machine Learning (ML) infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience in B2C or e-commerce software.

• Experience in debugging and resolving system issues, and addressing technical debt.

• Experience building scalable test automation frameworks for complex, AI systems.

• Experience in C++ and Python.

• Deep understanding of ML/LLM systems.

• Strong analytical skills to interpret quality metrics, identify regression patterns, and drive data-informed modeling decisions.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In YouTube Shopping Creator, we leverage advanced infrastructure to empower creators in producing high-quality, shopping-enabled content. A key business priority is expanding the creator and shopping content and driving active engagement with shopping features.
 Our mission is to enable creators to launch and scale their Shopping journey through seamless activation, intelligent matchmaking, and data-driven inspiration.
 As a team, we drive growth by owning the Activation and Inspiration Critical User Journey's. Beyond onboarding, we create and leverage Creator Profiles and AI/ML predictive modeling to provide actionable insights, helping creators discover the best merchants, lucrative offers, and relevant products for their audience.
 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Responsibilities

• Lead the design and development of innovative ML/AI-driven models and features.

• Architect and build systems that deeply integrate LLMs and other AI technologies to provide intelligent recommendations.

• Drive integrations across multiple product partners, lead by strong collaborations and partnerships.

• Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Data Scientists, and other engineering teams to define and deliver the roadmap for ML/AI capabilities.

• Foster a collaborative environment.

## Early

Experience completing work as directed, and collaborating with teammates; developing knowledge of relevant concepts and processes.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Completed Bachelor's degree in Law from a Swiss University.
* Ability to communicate in German and English fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Academic curriculum including data protection, intellectual property, copyright, technology, or media law.
* Experience working on numerous projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience in a law firm or in a media/technology company.
* Experience, know-how or keen curiosity around discovering, developing and applying AI tools in practice.
* Available to start in between Sept and Oct 2026 for a 12 month fixed-term contract.

### About the job

As a Legal Trainee and part of the Google Regional Legal team, you will play an important role in helping us address the legal challenges at the forefront of the information age. You will get insights into a variety of legal work across Google and YouTube, learning to expect the unexpected while promoting the development of internet law in an unconventional environment.

In this role, you will be an integral part of the Swiss and Austrian legal team and will have the opportunity to deep dive into specific subject matters around technology law. You will have a chance to enhance your organizational and communication skills, while developing your advocacy and legal judgment. Our legal trainees learn, grow and grow in a fast-paced internationally connected environment organized across multiple jurisdictions and teams.

### Responsibilities

* Respond to various legal requests from users and third-parties in relation to Google services and resolve internal and external escalations.
* Assist the Legal team in the preparation, management of court submissions, and in subsequent analysis.
* Assist in a variety of projects, such as the localization of new Google Products, marketing assessments, and the review and drafting of agreements.
* Conduct research on a variety of legal topics and new regulations in the field of privacy, copyright, consumer law, media regulations, advertising, competition law, etc.
* Participate in the creation and maintenance of internal knowledge databases for the Legal team. Be an expert in Google AI tools and use them to help manage team tasks.

# Presto

Esperienza completando il lavoro come diretto e collaborando con i compagni di squadra; sviluppare la conoscenza di concetti e processi rilevanti.

Applicare

### Titolo minimo:

* Laurea completa in Giurisprudenza presso un'Università Svizzera.
* Capacità di comunicare in tedesco e inglese fluentemente per supportare la gestione dei rapporti con i clienti in questa regione.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Curriculum accademico tra cui protezione dei dati, proprietà intellettuale, copyright, tecnologia o diritto dei media.
* Esperienza di lavoro su numerosi progetti contemporaneamente in un ambiente veloce.
* Esperienza in uno studio legale o in una società di media/tecnologia.
* Esperienza, know-how o curiosità acuta intorno alla scoperta, lo sviluppo e l'applicazione di strumenti AI in pratica.
* Disponibile a partire da settembre e ottobre 2026 per un contratto a tempo determinato di 12 mesi.

### Riguardo al lavoro

In qualità di Legal Trainee e parte del team legale regionale di Google, si svolgerà un ruolo importante nell'aiutare a risolvere le sfide legali in prima linea dell'età dell'informazione. Si otterrà approfondimenti in una varietà di lavoro legale su Google e YouTube, imparando ad aspettarsi l'imprevisto mentre promuove lo sviluppo della legge Internet in un ambiente non convenzionale.

In questo ruolo, sarete parte integrante del team legale svizzero e austriaco e avrete l'opportunità di immergervi in materie specifiche in materia di diritto tecnologico. Avrete la possibilità di migliorare le vostre capacità organizzative e di comunicazione, sviluppando la vostra advocacy e giudizio legale. I nostri tirocinanti legali imparano, crescono e crescono in un ambiente collegato a livello internazionale veloce organizzato in più giurisdizioni e team.

### responsabilità

* Rispondere a varie richieste legali da parte degli utenti e di terze parti in relazione ai servizi di Google e risolvere escalazioni interne ed esterne.
* Assistere il team legale nella preparazione, gestione delle conclusioni del tribunale e nell'analisi successiva.
* Assistere in una varietà di progetti, come la localizzazione di nuovi prodotti Google, valutazioni di marketing, e la revisione e la stesura di accordi.
* Condurre la ricerca su una varietà di argomenti legali e nuove normative nel campo della privacy, del diritto d'autore, del diritto dei consumatori, della regolamentazione dei media, della pubblicità, della legge sulla concorrenza, ecc.
* Partecipa alla creazione e alla manutenzione di database di conoscenze interne per il team legale. Essere un esperto in strumenti di Google AI e utilizzarli per aiutare a gestire i compiti del team.

Beantragen

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* Abgeschlossener Bachelor in Rechtswissenschaften an einer Schweizer Universität.
* Fähigkeit, fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch zu kommunizieren, um das Kundenbeziehungsmanagement in dieser Region zu unterstützen.

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Akademisches Curriculum einschließlich Datenschutz, geistiges Eigentum, Urheberrecht, Technologie oder Medienrecht.
* Erfahrung in der gleichzeitigen Arbeit an zahlreichen Projekten in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung.
* Erfahrung in einer Anwaltskanzlei oder in einem Medien- / Technologieunternehmen.
* Erfahrung, Know-how oder Neugier rund um das Entdecken, Entwickeln und Anwenden von KI-Tools in der Praxis.
* Verfügbar, um zwischen September und Oktober 2026 für einen 12-monatigen befristeten Vertrag zu beginnen.

### Über den Job

Als Legal Trainee und Teil des Google Regional Legal Teams spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Bewältigung der rechtlichen Herausforderungen an der Spitze des Informationszeitalters. Sie erhalten Einblicke in eine Vielzahl von juristischen Arbeiten in Google und YouTube und lernen, das Unerwartete zu erwarten, während Sie die Entwicklung des Internetrechts in einer unkonventionellen Umgebung fördern.

In dieser Funktion sind Sie ein integraler Bestandteil des schweizerischen und österreichischen Rechtsteams und haben die Möglichkeit, tief in spezifische Themen rund um das Technologierecht einzutauchen. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Ihre organisatorischen und kommunikativen Fähigkeiten zu verbessern und gleichzeitig Ihre Interessenvertretung und Ihr rechtliches Urteilsvermögen zu entwickeln. Unsere Juristen lernen, wachsen und wachsen in einem schnelllebigen, international vernetzten Umfeld, das in mehreren Jurisdiktionen und Teams organisiert ist.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Reagieren Sie auf verschiedene rechtliche Anfragen von Nutzern und Dritten in Bezug auf Google-Dienste und lösen Sie interne und externe Eskalationen.
* Unterstützen Sie das Legal-Team bei der Vorbereitung, Verwaltung von Gerichtsvorlagen und bei der anschließenden Analyse.
* Unterstützung bei einer Vielzahl von Projekten, wie der Lokalisierung neuer Google-Produkte, Marketingbewertungen und der Überprüfung und Erstellung von Verträgen.
* Recherchieren Sie zu einer Vielzahl von rechtlichen Themen und neuen Vorschriften im Bereich Datenschutz, Urheberrecht, Verbraucherrecht, Medienvorschriften, Werbung, Wettbewerbsrecht usw.
* Beteiligen Sie sich an der Erstellung und Pflege interner Wissensdatenbanken für das Legal-Team. Seien Sie ein Experte für Google AI-Tools und verwenden Sie sie, um Teamaufgaben zu verwalten.

### Titres minimums:

* Capacité de communiquer en allemand et en anglais couramment pour soutenir la gestion de la relation client dans cette région.

### Titres préférés:

* Programme d'études comprenant la protection des données, la propriété intellectuelle, le droit d'auteur, la technologie ou le droit des médias.
* Expérience de travail sur de nombreux projets simultanément dans un environnement rapide.
* Expérience dans un cabinet d'avocats ou dans une société de médias/technologies.
* Expérience, savoir-faire ou curiosité à la découverte, au développement et à l'application d'outils d'IA en pratique.
* Disponible à partir de septembre à octobre 2026 pour un contrat à durée déterminée de 12 mois.

### Sur le travail

En tant que stagiaire juridique et faisant partie de l'équipe juridique régionale de Google, vous jouerez un rôle important en nous aidant à relever les défis juridiques à l'avant-garde de l'ère de l'information. Vous obtiendrez des informations sur une variété de travaux juridiques sur Google et YouTube, apprenant à s'attendre à l'inattendu tout en favorisant le développement du droit Internet dans un environnement non conventionnel.

Dans ce rôle, vous ferez partie intégrante de l'équipe juridique suisse et autrichienne et aurez l'occasion de plonger dans des sujets spécifiques autour du droit technologique. Vous aurez la chance d'améliorer vos compétences en matière d'organisation et de communication, tout en développant votre plaidoyer et votre jugement juridique. Nos stagiaires en droit apprennent, grandissent et grandissent dans un environnement de connexion internationale rapide organisé à travers plusieurs juridictions et équipes.

* Aider l'équipe juridique à préparer, à gérer les mémoires des tribunaux et à les analyser ultérieurement.
* Aider à divers projets, comme la localisation de nouveaux produits Google, les évaluations de marketing, ainsi que l'examen et la rédaction d'ententes.
* Mener des recherches sur divers sujets juridiques et nouveaux règlements dans le domaine de la vie privée, du droit d'auteur, du droit de la consommation, de la réglementation des médias, de la publicité, du droit de la concurrence, etc.
* Participer à la création et à la tenue à jour de bases de données internes sur les connaissances pour l'équipe juridique. Soyez un expert en outils Google AI et utilisez-les pour aider à gérer les tâches d'équipe.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in C++ programming language.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.
* 3 years of experience in computer vision and sensor fusion.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 3 years of experience working with embedded real-time systems.
* Expertise in the following areas: performance debugging and optimization of complex workloads, design of performance tools, compiler design and code optimization, high-performance software development techniques, concurrent programming, or multi-core computer architectures.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our team delivers research and performance optimization for the XR world-sensing stack. Our work spans device qualification and calibration, image processing, visual-inertial sensor fusion, IMU-based motion understanding, and end-to-end system verification. We power products across the entire XR ecosystem, including headsets, smart glasses, and mobile phones.

We operate in the 0-to-1 research-to-product space, building foundational visual-inertial fusion for odometry, localization, mapping, calibration, and head-tracking image processing. Our technology powers the AndroidXR ecosystem, including GalaxyXR and upcoming devices such as Aura.

In this role, you will push the boundaries of spatial computing to enable delightful Augmented Reality (AR) experiences. You will drive cross-functional ideation and development to chart the future capabilities of next-generation AR devices.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

### Responsibilities

* Develop head-tracking components of a variety of XR devices, using vision and IMU data in real-time/power constrained compute environments.
* Work with stakeholders to define requirements and drive algorithmic design, implementation, and end-to-end verification.
* Initiate, contribute to, or lead new research collaborations with partner teams to deliver novel technical components solving the toughest challenges facing consumer AR devices on commodity hardware.

# Mezzogiorno

Provate i progressi di guida, risolvendo i problemi, e guidando più membri del team junior; competenze più profonde e conoscenze applicate all'interno di area rilevante.

Applicare

### Titolo minimo:

* Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.
* 5 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo software nel linguaggio di programmazione C++.
* 3 anni di esperienza di test, manutenzione, o lancio di prodotti software.
* 3 anni di esperienza nella visione del computer e nella fusione dei sensori.

### Qualifiche preferenziali:

* Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o in campo tecnico correlato.
* 3 anni di esperienza di lavoro con sistemi in tempo reale incorporati.
* Competenza nelle seguenti aree: debug delle prestazioni e ottimizzazione dei carichi di lavoro complessi, progettazione di strumenti di performance, progettazione del compilatore e ottimizzazione del codice, tecniche di sviluppo del software ad alte prestazioni, programmazione concomitante, o architetture del computer multi-core.

### Riguardo al lavoro

Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Il nostro team offre la ricerca e l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni per lo stack XR. Il nostro lavoro abbraccia la qualificazione e la calibrazione del dispositivo, l'elaborazione delle immagini, la fusione del sensore visivo-inrtial, la comprensione del movimento basata su IMU e la verifica del sistema end-to-end. Alimentiamo i prodotti attraverso l'intero ecosistema XR, inclusi cuffie, occhiali intelligenti e telefoni cellulari.

Operiamo nello spazio 0-to-1 di ricerca-prodotto, costruendo una fusione visiva-inertiale fondamentale per l'odometria, la localizzazione, la mappatura, la calibrazione e l'elaborazione di immagini di tracciamento. La nostra tecnologia alimenta l'ecosistema AndroidXR, tra cui GalaxyXR e i prossimi dispositivi come Aura.

In questo ruolo, si spingerà i confini del calcolo spaziale per consentire piacevoli esperienze Augmented Reality (AR). Potrai guidare l'ideazione e lo sviluppo interfunzionali per tracciare le capacità future dei dispositivi AR di nuova generazione.

Il team di Piattaforme e Dispositivi comprende le varie piattaforme software di elaborazione di Google in ambienti (desktop, mobile, applicazioni), così come i nostri dispositivi e servizi di prima parte che combinano il meglio di Google AI, software e hardware. Squadre in questa area di ricerca, progettazione e sviluppo di nuove tecnologie per rendere l'interazione del nostro utente con l'informatica più veloce e senza soluzione di continuità, costruendo esperienze innovative per i nostri utenti in tutto il mondo.

### responsabilità

* Sviluppare componenti di tracciamento della testa di una varietà di dispositivi XR, utilizzando i dati di visione e IMU in ambienti di calcolo basati in tempo reale/potenza.
* Lavorare con gli stakeholder per definire i requisiti e guidare la progettazione algoritmica, l'implementazione e la verifica end-to-end.
* Iniziare, contribuire a, o condurre nuove collaborazioni di ricerca con i team partner per fornire nuovi componenti tecnici risolvendo le sfide più difficili che affrontano i dispositivi AR dei consumatori sull'hardware delle materie prime.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in C++ programming language.
* 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.
* 3 years of experience in computer vision and sensor fusion.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 3 years of experience working with embedded real-time systems.
* Expertise in the following areas: performance debugging and optimization of complex workloads, design of performance tools, compiler design and code optimization, high-performance software development techniques, concurrent programming, or multi-core computer architectures.

### About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our team delivers research and performance optimization for the XR world-sensing stack. Our work spans device qualification and calibration, image processing, visual-inertial sensor fusion, IMU-based motion understanding, and end-to-end system verification. We power products across the entire XR ecosystem, including headsets, smart glasses, and mobile phones.

We operate in the 0-to-1 research-to-product space, building foundational visual-inertial fusion for odometry, localization, mapping, calibration, and head-tracking image processing. Our technology powers the AndroidXR ecosystem, including GalaxyXR and upcoming devices such as Aura.

In this role, you will push the boundaries of spatial computing to enable delightful Augmented Reality (AR) experiences. You will drive cross-functional ideation and development to chart the future capabilities of next-generation AR devices.

The Platforms and Devices team encompasses Google's various computing software platforms across environments (desktop, mobile, applications), as well as our first party devices and services that combine the best of Google AI, software, and hardware. Teams across this area research, design, and develop new technologies to make our user's interaction with computing faster and more seamless, building innovative experiences for our users around the world.

### Responsibilities

* Develop head-tracking components of a variety of XR devices, using vision and IMU data in real-time/power constrained compute environments.
* Work with stakeholders to define requirements and drive algorithmic design, implementation, and end-to-end verification.
* Initiate, contribute to, or lead new research collaborations with partner teams to deliver novel technical components solving the toughest challenges facing consumer AR devices on commodity hardware.

## Mitte

Erleben Sie, wie Sie Fortschritte vorantreiben, Probleme lösen und mehr jüngere Teammitglieder betreuen; tieferes Fachwissen und angewandtes Wissen in relevanten Bereichen.

Beantragen

### Mindestqualifikationen:

* Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.
* 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Softwareentwicklung in der Programmiersprache C++.
* 3 Jahre Erfahrung beim Testen, Warten oder Starten von Softwareprodukten.
* 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Computer Vision und Sensorfusion.

### Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

* Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereich.
* 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit eingebetteten Echtzeitsystemen.
* Expertise in folgenden Bereichen: Performance Debugging und Optimierung komplexer Workloads, Design von Performance Tools, Compiler-Design und Code-Optimierung, Hochleistungs-Softwareentwicklungstechniken, Concurrent Programming oder Multi-Core-Computerarchitekturen.

### Über den Job

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Unser Team liefert Forschung und Leistungsoptimierung für den XR World-Sensing Stack. Unsere Arbeit umfasst Gerätequalifikation und -kalibrierung, Bildverarbeitung, Visual-Inertial Sensor Fusion, IMU-basiertes Bewegungsverständnis und End-to-End-Systemverifikation. Wir betreiben Produkte im gesamten XR-Ökosystem, einschließlich Headsets, Datenbrillen und Mobiltelefonen.

Wir arbeiten im 0-zu-1-Forschungs-zu-Produkt-Raum und bauen eine grundlegende visuelle Trägheitsfusion für Odometrie, Lokalisierung, Kartierung, Kalibrierung und Head-Tracking-Bildverarbeitung auf. Unsere Technologie unterstützt das AndroidXR-Ökosystem, einschließlich GalaxyXR und neuer Geräte wie Aura.

In dieser Rolle werden Sie die Grenzen des Spatial Computing erweitern, um angenehme Augmented Reality (AR) -Erfahrungen zu ermöglichen. Sie werden funktionsübergreifende Ideenfindung und Entwicklung vorantreiben, um die zukünftigen Fähigkeiten von AR-Geräten der nächsten Generation zu kartieren.

Das Platforms and Devices-Team umfasst die verschiedenen Computer-Softwareplattformen von Google in allen Umgebungen (Desktop, Mobile, Anwendungen) sowie unsere First-Party-Geräte und -Dienste, die das Beste aus Google AI, Software und Hardware kombinieren. Teams in diesem Bereich erforschen, entwerfen und entwickeln neue Technologien, um die Interaktion unserer Benutzer mit dem Computing schneller und nahtloser zu gestalten und innovative Erlebnisse für unsere Benutzer auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen.

### Zuständigkeiten

* Entwicklung von Head-Tracking-Komponenten einer Vielzahl von XR-Geräten unter Verwendung von Vision- und IMU-Daten in Echtzeit-/Power-Constrained-Compute-Umgebungen.
* Arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um Anforderungen zu definieren und algorithmisches Design, Implementierung und End-to-End-Verifizierung voranzutreiben.
* Initiieren, beteiligen oder leiten Sie neue Forschungskooperationen mit Partnerteams, um neuartige technische Komponenten bereitzustellen, die die schwierigsten Herausforderungen für AR-Geräte für Verbraucher auf handelsüblicher Hardware lösen.

## Moyenne

Expérience de la conduite des progrès, de la résolution des problèmes et du mentorat d'un plus grand nombre de membres de l'équipe junior; expertise approfondie et connaissances appliquées dans le domaine pertinent.

Appliquer

### Titres minimums:

* Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.
* 5 ans d'expérience dans le développement de logiciels en langage de programmation C++.
* 3 ans d'expérience en test, maintenance ou lancement de produits logiciels.
* 3 ans d'expérience en vision informatique et fusion de capteurs.

### Titres préférés:

* Maîtrise ou doctorat en informatique ou domaine technique connexe.
* 3 ans d'expérience avec des systèmes embarqués en temps réel.
* Expertise dans les domaines suivants : débogage de la performance et optimisation de charges de travail complexes, conception d'outils de performance, conception de compilateur et optimisation de code, techniques de développement de logiciel haute performance, programmation simultanée, ou architectures informatiques multi-cœurs.

### Sur le travail

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique aux besoins de Google avec des possibilités de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile complète alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Notre équipe fournit la recherche et l'optimisation des performances pour la pile de détection du monde XR. Notre travail couvre la qualification et l'étalonnage des appareils, le traitement d'images, la fusion visuelle-inertiale des capteurs, la compréhension du mouvement basée sur l'IMU, et la vérification du système de bout en bout. Nous alimentons des produits dans tout l'écosystème XR, y compris des casques, des lunettes intelligentes et des téléphones mobiles.

Nous opérons dans l'espace de recherche à produit de 0 à 1, en construisant une fusion fondamentale visuelle à inertie pour l'odométrie, la localisation, la cartographie, l'étalonnage et le traitement de l'image de tête. Notre technologie alimente l'écosystème AndroidXR, y compris GalaxyXR et les appareils à venir comme Aura.

Dans ce rôle, vous repousserez les limites de l'informatique spatiale pour permettre de délicieuses expériences de réalité augmentée (AR). Vous conduirez l'idée et le développement interfonctionnels pour tracer les capacités futures des appareils AR de prochaine génération.

L'équipe Platforms and Devices regroupe les différentes plates-formes logicielles de Google à travers les environnements (desktop, mobile, applications), ainsi que nos premiers appareils et services qui combinent le meilleur de Google AI, logiciels et matériel. Des équipes dans ce domaine étudient, conçoivent et développent de nouvelles technologies pour rendre l'interaction de notre utilisateur avec l'informatique plus rapide et plus transparente, en créant des expériences innovantes pour nos utilisateurs dans le monde entier.

### Responsabilités

* Développez des composants de suivi de tête d'une variété de périphériques XR, en utilisant des données de vision et d'IMU dans des environnements de calcul en temps réel/en puissance.
* Collaborer avec les intervenants pour définir les exigences et diriger la conception algorithmique, la mise en oeuvre et la vérification de bout en bout.
* Initier, contribuer ou diriger de nouvelles collaborations de recherche avec des équipes partenaires afin de fournir de nouveaux composants techniques qui résolvent les défis les plus difficiles auxquels sont confrontés les appareils AR de consommation sur le matériel de base.

## Mid

Experience driving progress, solving problems, and mentoring more junior team members; deeper expertise and applied knowledge within relevant area.

Apply

### Minimum qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, and with data structures and algorithms.

### Preferred qualifications:

* Background in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Computational Biology, or a related technical field.
* Strong hands-on experience with deep learning and agentic frameworks and developing in both Python and C++.
* Proven track record of carrying out quantitative data analysis and translating complex research ideas into concrete engineering features.
* Ability to drive independent research from initial ideas to publication or product implementation.

### About the job

Google Cloud’s mission is to make every business successful through AI by combining cutting-edge technology, infrastructure, and talent. AI/ML software engineers in Cloud bridge the gap between pioneering models and a massive product vehicle reaching billions. Our talent density and AI-powered tools drive rapid development, rooted in a culture of empowerment and a bias to action. In this role, you aren’t just building technology; you’re shaping the frontier of enterprise and driving the evolution of advanced models.

Co-Scientist is a research team with the mission to accelerate scientific discovery with Artificial Intelligence (AI). We do much of the research behind Google’s Co-Scientist product which is an Agentic AI system for science. We also work with scientists inside and outside of Google on some of their biggest challenges.

In this role you will develop a system for scientific discovery which entails literature research, data analysis, hypothesis generation and validation. You will use Google’s latest AI tools and models and have the opportunity to collaborate with scientists in Google and from universities and partner labs.

The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

### Responsibilities

* Own projects end-to-end, taking software systems from initial design and prototyping to full deployment and analysis.
* Design, build, deploy, and scale agentic AI systems, robust tool-use mechanisms, and multi-agent tournament workflows.
* Build robust system evaluation pipelines and curate diagnostic datasets to systematically measure agentic accuracy and progress.
* Collaborate with scientists and researchers across Google DeepMind, Google Research, and prestigious external academic partners to publish original research.
